Empty Space Skipping - TU Wien
Another approach is space leaping [4, 50, 6]. Here, a distance transform is applied to the volume to calculate a "proximity" or "skip" value for each empty cell which encodes the distance to the nearest opaque cell. The value therefore is the distance that can be safely skipped along any ray that samples this cell.
